title: Ethena Pay Adds Earn+ Through Aave V4 Lending on Avalanche
summary: Ethena Pay’s Earn+ routes deposits into an Upshift vault curated by Steakhouse and using Aave V4 on Avalanche. The layered structure matters when assessing rewards and withdrawals.

title: Circle Asks SEC to Clarify Cash Treatment for Qualifying Payment Stablecoins
summary: Circle’s comment letter asks the SEC to align its crypto-asset proposal with payment-stablecoin rules. The company’s requested treatment remains a policy position, not a Commission decision.

title: Cosmos Prepares ATOM Tokenomics Review With Separate Governance Proposals
summary: Cosmos contributors say tokenomics research has reached the preparation stage for public review. Proposed changes will be discussed individually, rather than treated as an already approved redesign.

title: Ambire Ice Puts Safe Owner Changes and Approval Thresholds on the Signing Screen
summary: Ambire says its Ice hardware wallet will decode Safe transactions and flag changes to account control. The design targets the decisions signers make before authorizing an action.

title: ECB Picks Digital Euro Network Providers as Pilot Infrastructure Takes Shape
summary: The ECB has selected two provider groups for digital euro connectivity. The contracts support pilot preparation and possible future issuance, without deciding whether the currency will launch.

title: Bitcoin Core 32.1 Arrives With Privacy Fixes and New Compatibility Checks
summary: Bitcoin Core 32.1 introduces network, privacy and interface changes, while 31.2 and 30.4 provide maintenance updates. Operators need to check integrations as well as version numbers.

title: Mercado Bitcoin Plans Sui Asset Access in Brazil With Lending and Tokenization Links
summary: Mercado Bitcoin and Sui have outlined access to SUI and stablecoins, with USDsui collateral and tokenized assets in scope. A potential Hashi integration remains exploratory.

title: XRP Ledger Reviews Two Token-Authorization Fixes Ahead of Any Validator Vote
summary: Two open XRP Ledger proposals address authorization checks for liquidity-pool tokens and existing trust-line balances. The changes remain under review and are not active network rules.

title: Polymarket Sets $3.9M Refund Plan After Third-Party Script Compromise
summary: Polymarket says its October 29 incident involved a compromised monitoring script. Its October 30 update put total refunds at $3.9 million, including losses linked to the trading pause.

title: KuCoin Announces Russia and Belarus Exit With Individual Account Deadlines
summary: KuCoin says it is discontinuing all services for users in Russia and Belarus. Affected accounts will receive their own deadlines for closing positions and withdrawing assets.
